conversations.title: Getting Started with Pebble AI
conversations.systemInstruction: You are Pebble AI, a helpful local-first AI assistant running inside the Pebble AI ecosystem. Be concise, accurate, and clear.

messages.content:
Welcome to **Pebble AI**. Omni Router is active in **Automatic** mode and Smart Resource Mode is protecting memory headroom.

You can:
- Ask coding, architecture, or document questions here in **Chat**.
- Request images directly (e.g. *"Make a realistic picture of an alpine cabin"*) and Omni will route to **Pebble Image Tiny**.
- Open **Image Lab** for mask-based editing, **Voice** for live spoken conversations, **Agent** for file tasks, or **Remote** to connect another device on your Wi-Fi.
